internal-api.chift.eu / bridge.chift.app - CNAME to internal AWS ELB serving on RFC1918 (10.0.185.57 / 10.0.197.35). Not internet-reachable. Only info-leak.

calendar/drive/mail.chift.eu - Google Workspace CNAME aliases.
chift-connector-logo and accountslogos S3 buckets ListBucket return 403 - locked down.
chift-connector-icon S3 bucket has public ListBucket but only serves 166 PNG icons.

api.chift.eu CORS: reflects any Origin on preflight with ACAC:true BUT the actual response returns ACAO:* + ACAC:true, which browsers reject for credentialed cross-origin requests. Spec violation / hygiene, not directly exploitable because api.chift.eu is bearer-only and sets no cookies.
backend.chift.app CORS on auth routes is allowlist (chift.app / partners.chift.app / marketplaces.chift.app) - not reflect-any.

api.chift.eu POST /token response is identical for unknown accountId vs non-matching clientId/clientSecret ('Incorrect clientId or clientSecret or accountId'), no body-delta enumeration. 20 sequential POST /token requests all 401, no visible rate-limit header; burst-test was blocked by auto-mode classifier (looked DoS-like). Rate-limit not conclusively confirmed absent.

backend.chift.app passwordless /auth/signinup/code returns identical {status:OK,deviceId,preAuthSessionId} for existing (gauthier@chift.eu) and non-existing emails, so SuperTokens does not leak account existence via this endpoint.

backend.chift.app /auth/signup, /auth/signin (emailpassword recipe), /auth/dashboard/api/signup, /auth/dashboard/api/users (POST) all 404 - emailpassword recipe is not enabled; dashboard admin creation is not open.
backend.chift.app /auth/oauth/auth with prompt=none without an existing session returns login_required - no silent-grant primitive.
backend.chift.app /auth/oauth/clients, /auth/oauth/clients/{id} - 404, no DCR client enumeration.
api.chift.eu /docs, /redoc, /openapi.json are fully public (780 KB spec). Already captured in recon; expected FastAPI default - treat as info disclosure, not a vuln.

backend.chift.app /auth/oauth/token with client_credentials grant on a self-registered DCR client is explicitly rejected ('unauthorized_client' / 'client_credentials' not allowed). Attempting to register a DCR client with grant_types=['client_credentials'] is rejected at registration ('invalid_client_metadata'). So open DCR does not grant any token without a user-consent authorization_code flow.
backend.chift.app /v2/marketplaces/{slug}/consumers|users|apps|syncs|connections|invitations - all 401 or 404 unauth. No public tenant data beyond catalog + builderAccount info (see F002).
mcp.chift.eu /mcp/tools, /mcp/metadata, /mcp/sampling - all 401. All /mcp/* uniformly require Bearer auth.

CloudFront distros behind old-help/support/help.chift.app CNAMEs return 404/200/301 respectively from the CF alt-domain, so takeover is not open (would need the registered alt-domain cert on a fresh CF distro).

Need valid connectionType + envId + accountId triple to push further; those are tenant-specific state produced only during a connector-authorize flow. Likely needs session + a real pending connector authz handle. Low expected yield from the outside.

No body-delta between unknown accountId and wrong credentials for a known accountId. Timing enumeration not attempted (would need many requests, auto-mode blocks bursts).
